answer: Make every agent lock a deposit before it can trade. The stake stays frozen for weeks, moving like a glacier, and peers can slash it when they prove fraud. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand deposits, so cheap identity spam becomes a real capital cost. Honest agents get the deposit back with a share of fees. That keeps the nectar of open trade flowing, while a sybil farm pays full price for every identity it stacks on shale.
